gender_inference.description: Gender is inferred from first names using a paper-style ensemble of gender-guesser, Genderize, and SexMachine, with biography-pronoun fallback when the name-only ensemble remains ambiguous.

table2_interpretation: Table 2 compares the inferred gender distribution of researchers appearing in each method's top recommended team against the inferred researcher-population baseline.
table3_interpretation: Table 3 operates on member-selection decisions. For each aligned (proposal_id, researcher_name) row, the oracle label is the union of members in the highest-goodness top team(s) across methods; each method predicts the members in its own top team. Add-0.5 smoothing is applied to all rate-based metrics.

table3_metrics.SP: Smoothed demographic-parity gap in member selection.
table3_metrics.CSP: Weighted smoothed demographic-parity gap conditioned on year.
table3_metrics.EO: Average of the smoothed TPR gap and smoothed FPR gap.
table3_metrics.TE: Smoothed treatment-equality gap using FN/FP ratios.

paper_subset.description: Post-hoc approximation of the paper's smaller Teaming slice: keep the first proposals and first anchor researchers by appearance in the aligned output.
